name: us_sec_edgar-mcp
description: SEC EDGAR company search (sales): get_company. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_us_sec_edgar_contact.title: PLATFORM_MCP_US_SEC_EDGAR_CONTACT
platform_mcp_us_sec_edgar_contact.description: Company name and e-mail, required by SEC fair-access rules: 'Sample Company Name AdminContact@<sample company domain>.com' is appended to the User-Agent (https://www.sec.gov/os/accessing-edgar-data). Env: PLATFORM_MCP_US_SEC_EDGAR_CONTACT.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: `id` MUST be the 10-digit zero-padded CIK ('https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json, where ########## is the entity's 10-digit central index key (CIK), including leading zeros'), e.g. 0000320193 — the adapter does not pad it. `industry` is sicDescription (sic code under raw.sic); `address` is the business street line (city, stateOrCountry, zipCode under raw.addresses.business); tickers, exchanges, formerNames and the filings index stay under raw. `website` is often empty.
